_README: Deductions applied to the fit score where a review found a clash with the criteria. Keys are model_key; points are negative. Rerun tools/build_watchlist.py after editing.

HW-QS90H.reason: HDMI passthrough caps at 4K/60, below the panel and console it will sit between

ARC ULTRA.reason: no HDMI input at all: eARC only, so nothing can be routed through the bar

SMART ULTRA SOUNDBAR.reason: no HDMI input, and no DTS:X decoding
height effects rated below the Sonos Arc Ultra's by reviewers comparing them directly

S95TR.reason: five height channels on paper, but reviewers found the height imaging behind Samsung's and Sonos'

HT-A7100.reason: no EQ adjustment of any kind

HW-Q990H.reason: compact subwoofer: controlled but shallower than a standalone sub, per AVS Forum's measurements
